name: SureWP App-Style Bottom Menu
author: surewp

sections.description:
SureWP App-Style Bottom Menu adds a sleek, modern bottom navigation menu to your WordPress site, perfect for creating an app-like mobile experience.

Features

  • App-style bottom navigation menu for mobile devices
  • Fully customizable menu items (up to 5 items)
  • Light, Dark, and Custom color themes
  • WooCommerce cart integration with live item count
  • Built-in search modal
  • Elementor widget support for page-specific menus
  • Dashicons and Font Awesome icon support
  • Responsive design (mobile-first)
  • Easy-to-use admin interface
  • AJAX-powered cart count updates

Perfect For

  • E-commerce sites using WooCommerce
  • Mobile-first websites
  • App-like user experiences
  • Improving mobile navigation
  • Websites built with Elementor

Special Menu Items

  • Cart: Add a menu item with label “Cart” to show WooCommerce cart with live item count
  • Search: Add a menu item with label “Search” to open a full-page search modal

Elementor Integration

Use the Elementor widget to add page-specific bottom menus with full visual customization options.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/surewp-app-bottom-menu/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Bottom Menu settings page to configure your menu items and theme.
  4. (Optional) If using Elementor, drag the Mobile Bottom Menu widget onto your pages.
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The plugin includes special cart integration that displays the cart icon with a live item count badge.

Can I use this with Elementor?

Yes! The plugin includes a dedicated Elementor widget for creating page-specific bottom menus.

How many menu items can I add?

You can add up to 5 menu items to the bottom menu.

What icons are supported?

The plugin supports both WordPress Dashicons (dashicons-) and Font Awesome icons (fa fa-).

Can I show the cart only on WooCommerce pages?

Yes! There’s a setting to show the cart icon only on WooCommerce-related pages (shop, product, cart, checkout).
